clearance_metric: minimum 5th percentile of positive depth in central third over four cardinal views at three heights
nohit: reject any nonambiguous no-hit at the 40 feature centres
scope: Reject horizontal feature rays crossing >0.3m beyond assigned floor scope dilated 0.25m before furnished hit, or >5% central-band sampled depth endpoints outside dilated scope. No map-vs-furniture depth agreement required.
